nodes.description: Administrator address, initialised to msg.sender; guard for onlyAdmin functions and part of the onlyAuthorized check.
Controller contract address; authorized caller and source of the treasury address used in harvest().
Immutable vault address; authorized caller and counterparty of underlying token transfers.
Immutable underlying ERC20 token (BUSD); protected from sweep().
Total underlying transferred from the vault; updated by _increaseDebt, _decreaseDebt, skim and harvest.
Performance fee in basis points, capped by PERFORMANCE_FEE_CAP, applied to harvest profit.
Slippage tolerance used to compute the min amount for Curve add/remove liquidity calls.
Multiplier used in skim() to bound totalAssets against totalDebt * delta / DELTA_MIN.
Flag that, when true, makes exit() return immediately instead of exiting the strategy.
Constant upper limit (2000) enforced by setPerformanceFee.
Constant denominator (10000) for the performance fee computation in harvest().
Constant denominator (10000) used in the slippage min-amount computation.
Constant denominator (10000) for the delta based manipulation guard in skim().
Curve pool index of the underlying token, set to 3 (BUSD) by StrategyBusdBusdV2.
Per-index precision divisors converting 1e18 amounts to the underlying token decimals.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for admin initialisation and access-control modifiers.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed directly as the Uniswap swap deadline in _swap.
Sets admin, controller, vault and underlying; validates non-zero addresses.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == admin.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to be admin, controller or vault.
Admin-only update of the admin address.
Admin-only update of the controller address.
Admin-only update of performanceFee, bounded by PERFORMANCE_FEE_CAP.
Admin-only update of slippage, bounded by SLIPPAGE_MAX.
Admin-only update of delta, lower bounded by DELTA_MIN.
Admin-only toggle of the forceExit flag.
Pulls underlying from the vault via safeTransferFrom and increases totalDebt by the balance delta.
Sends underlying to the vault via safeTransfer and decreases totalDebt by the balance delta.
External view returning the strategy's underlying value via the virtual _totalAssets().
Authorized entry point that increases debt and invests underlying into Curve/gauge.
Converts an underlying amount into LP shares using the proportional formula.
Authorized entry point that redeems shares and transfers underlying back to the vault.
Redeems all shares, repays the vault and zeroes totalDebt.
Authorized external wrapper around _withdrawAll().
Authorized profit accounting with price-manipulation guard based on delta.
Deploys the Curve BUSD strategy and grants unlimited CRV approval to Uniswap.
Values the gauge LP balance using Curve get_virtual_price and precision divisors.
Approves and adds liquidity to Curve DepositBusd, then stakes the LP tokens in the gauge.
Deposits the underlying token into Curve via _depositIntoCurve.
Returns the gauge LP balance owned by the strategy.
Unstakes LP from the gauge and removes liquidity from Curve into the underlying token.
Reads Curve balances and returns the address and index of the lowest-balance pool token.
Swaps a token to another through Uniswap using block.timestamp as deadline.
Mints CRV through the Minter and swaps it into the target underlying token.
Authorized harvest: claims rewards, pays performance fee to treasury and reinvests.
Authorized exit: claims rewards into underlying and withdraws everything to the vault.
Admin-only rescue of accidentally sent tokens, blocking the underlying token.
Concrete BUSD strategy constructor; sets underlyingIndex = 3.
Performs a low-level value call to an arbitrary target with arbitrary data.
Sends ETH to an arbitrary payable recipient using a low-level call.
Builds calldata for an ERC20 call and routes it through Address.functionCall.
External Uniswap swap with amountOutMin = 1, i.e. effectively no slippage protection.
External Curve add_liquidity call minting LP tokens with a min-amount guard.
External Curve remove_liquidity_one_coin call with donateDust = false.
External gauge staking call that locks LP tokens.
External gauge unstaking call that returns LP tokens.
External Curve Minter call that mints CRV to the gauge.
External ERC20 value transfers (to vault, treasury, admin or from vault).
Raw .call{value:}() transferring control to an arbitrary external address.
Constructor parameter for the controller address.
Constructor parameter for the vault address.
Constructor parameter for the underlying token address.
New admin address passed to setAdmin.
New performance fee passed to setPerformanceFee.
New slippage tolerance passed to setSlippage.
New delta multiplier passed to setDelta.
New forceExit flag passed to setForceExit.
Amount of underlying to pull from the vault in deposit().
Amount of underlying to return to the vault in withdraw().
Token address to rescue in sweep(); must not be the underlying token.
Curve pool index of the token being deposited in _depositIntoCurve.
LP share amount to redeem in StrategyBusdV2._withdraw.
Underlying token balance of the strategy inside harvest().
Performance fee amount computed from the harvested balance.
Treasury address fetched from the controller during harvest().
Index of the lowest-balance Curve pool token in _getMostPremiumToken.
Difference between total underlying and total debt in skim().
Manipulation bound totalDebt * delta / DELTA_MIN used in skim().

edges.reason: onlyAdmin compares msg.sender with the stored admin address to gate privileged functions.
onlyAuthorized accepts msg.sender if it equals admin, controller or vault.
The constructor assigns ownership of the strategy to msg.sender (admin = msg.sender).
_swap uses block.timestamp directly as the Uniswap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
The miner-influenced timestamp is forwarded as an always-valid swap deadline to Uniswap.
setAdmin is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setController is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setPerformanceFee is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setSlippage is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setDelta is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
setForceExit is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
sweep is protected by the onlyAdmin modifier.
deposit is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
withdraw is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
withdrawAll is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
skim is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
harvest is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
exit is restricted to admin, controller or vault via onlyAuthorized.
Constructor stores msg.sender into the admin state variable.
Constructor writes the supplied controller address into state.
Constructor writes the supplied vault address into immutable state.
Constructor writes the supplied underlying address into immutable state.
setAdmin overwrites the admin state variable.
setController overwrites the controller state variable.
setPerformanceFee overwrites performanceFee after the cap check.
setSlippage overwrites slippage after the max check.
setDelta overwrites delta after the min check.
setForceExit overwrites the forceExit flag.
The _controller constructor parameter is consumed by the StrategyERC20 constructor.
The _vault constructor parameter initialises the immutable vault field.
The _underlying constructor parameter initialises the immutable underlying field.
The _admin parameter of setAdmin becomes the new admin.
The _fee parameter becomes the new performance fee.
The _slippage parameter becomes the new slippage tolerance.
The _delta parameter becomes the new delta multiplier.
The _forceExit parameter becomes the new forceExit flag.
The deposit amount parameter controls how much underlying is pulled from the vault.
The withdraw amount parameter controls share redemption and vault repayment.
The sweep token parameter selects which token balance is transferred to admin.
The index parameter selects the Curve pool position used for add_liquidity.
The LP amount parameter drives the gauge withdrawal and Curve removal.
The harvested token balance determines whether fees are paid and funds reinvested.
The computed fee is transferred to the treasury inside harvest.
The treasury address returned by the controller receives the performance fee.
minIndex tracks the lowest-balance Curve pool token in _getMostPremiumToken.
profit = totalUnderlying - totalDebt drives the debt increase or withdrawal branch.
max bounds totalUnderlying to detect possible price manipulation in skim.
_increaseDebt performs an external safeTransferFrom pulling underlying from the vault.
totalDebt is increased by balance delta using SafeMath inside _increaseDebt.
_decreaseDebt performs an external safeTransfer of underlying to the vault.
totalDebt is decreased by the balance difference inside _decreaseDebt.
deposit calls _increaseDebt to account for the newly received underlying.
deposit calls the virtual _deposit implementation to invest into Curve.
withdraw converts the requested underlying amount into LP shares.
withdraw calls the virtual _withdraw to redeem share tokens.
withdraw calls _decreaseDebt to return underlying to the vault.
_withdrawAll reads the total shares held by the strategy.
_withdrawAll redeems all shares through the virtual _withdraw.
_withdrawAll repays the vault using _decreaseDebt.
withdrawAll is a thin wrapper around _withdrawAll.
skim computes the shares corresponding to the profit amount.
skim redeems profit shares through the virtual _withdraw when out of bounds.
skim transfers the withdrawn profit to the vault.
skim increases or reconciles totalDebt based on the profit.
_depositIntoCurve approves and calls DepositBusd.add_liquidity.
_depositIntoCurve stakes the minted LP tokens via LiquidityGauge.deposit.
_depositIntoCurve uses PRECISION_DIV to normalise the deposited amount.
_depositIntoCurve derives the min LP amount from the slippage setting.
_deposit forwards the underlying token and index to _depositIntoCurve.
StrategyBusdV2._withdraw unstakes LP tokens from the gauge.
StrategyBusdV2._withdraw removes liquidity from Curve via remove_liquidity_one_coin.
StrategyBusdV2._withdraw uses PRECISION_DIV to compute the underlying amount.
StrategyBusdV2._withdraw derives the min underlying amount from slippage.
_swap invokes the external Uniswap router swapExactTokensForTokens.
_swap passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
_claimRewards calls the Curve Minter to mint CRV to the gauge.
_claimRewards swaps the claimed CRV for the target token via _swap.
harvest first selects the most premium token via _getMostPremiumToken.
harvest claims and swaps rewards through _claimRewards.
harvest transfers the performance fee to the treasury address.
harvest reinvests the remaining balance via _depositIntoCurve.
exit reads the forceExit flag to decide whether to abort.
exit claims rewards converted into the underlying token.
exit withdraws all strategy funds back to the vault.
sweep verifies the rescued token is not the protected underlying token.
sweep transfers the full token balance to the admin.
StrategyBusdBusdV2 constructor invokes the StrategyBusdV2 constructor.
StrategyBusdBusdV2 constructor sets underlyingIndex to 3 (BUSD).
StrategyBusdV2 constructor invokes the StrategyERC20 constructor.
StrategyBusdV2 constructor initialises the controller address.
StrategyBusdV2 constructor initialises the immutable vault address.
_callOptionalReturn routes token calls through Address.functionCall/functionCallWithValue.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call with value to an arbitrary target, enabling reentrancy.
sendValue performs a low-level .call{value:} to an arbitrary recipient, enabling reentrancy.
The Uniswap router call made during harvest re-enters attacker-controlled code while harvest still holds tokens.
The Curve remove_liquidity_one_coin call reachable from skim can re-enter before totalDebt is reconciled.

Constructor parameter used only to initialise the immutable vault state variable.
Constructor parameter used only to initialise the immutable underlying state variable.
Only input to setAdmin; directly assigned to the admin state variable.
Only input to setPerformanceFee; bounded then written to performanceFee.
Only input to setSlippage; bounded then written to slippage.
Only input to setDelta; bounded then written to delta.
Only input to setForceExit; written directly to the forceExit flag.
Drives the vault pull and debt increase in deposit; no independent semantic identity.
Drives share redemption and vault repayment in withdraw.
Selects the token to rescue in sweep and is checked against the protected underlying.
Selects the Curve pool position and precision divisor during the deposit.
Amount of gauge shares unstaked and converted back to the underlying token.
Transient harvested balance that gates fee payment and reinvestment inside harvest.
Derived performance fee value that is immediately transferred to the treasury.
Address fetched from the controller solely to receive the fee inside harvest.
Loop accumulator used only to choose the returned token and index.
Intermediate subtraction result that drives the skim branching logic.
Manipulation bound computed from delta and totalDebt, used only inside skim.
